'''Z9-V86''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] active during the [[war against Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] it resided on [[Zakuul]], the capital world of the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Z9-V86 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as a vendor for the "Eternal Championship."

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
